name: comp-477
title: Interactive Selectable Table
description: A dark table of five accounts, each row starting with a checkbox. Columns cover name, email, country flag and city, a status pill, and a right-aligned balance, with a total row underneath.
use: People pick several rows to act on together and need a footer total for the loaded records.
avoid: Rows come from a remote JSON, so the table stays empty until that request finishes.
a11y: Row and select-all checkboxes have aria labels and work from the keyboard; status is spelled out in the badge text. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A thin white-lined table on near-black, led by a narrow checkbox column. Names are bold, locations begin with a small waving flag emoji, statuses sit in rounded pills (green for Active, grey for Inactive), and money lines up at the right. A divider separates a Total row.
behaves: Ticking a row's box marks that row selected; the header box selects or clears every row at once. The header box shows a dash while only some rows are chosen, and the footer total follows the loaded data.
customise: Column definitions, the fetch URL and the five-row limit are written in the file; changing the data source, columns or currency means editing the source.
weight: moderate: A table library builds the grid over five remote rows; no animation loop.
